panels.title: Is anyone using it, and does it work
Model turns, by source
panels.description: The repair loop (design_agent) usually outnumbers the chat pane. If chat_pane is the only line here, the loop is not running.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.source, set: ${source:json}) or ${source:json}[0] == "$__all")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["source"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "turns"})

panels.title: Turn duration — median and p90
panels.description: Median and p90, never a mean: one 300s timeout among twenty 2s turns moves a mean by fifteen seconds and says nothing about a typical turn.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "median")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.9, column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p90")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Turn outcomes
panels.description: Anything other than ok. timeout and empty_reply mean the backend; stopped means the user pressed Stop.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])
  |> count()

panels.title: Failure rate
panels.description: Share of model turns that did not return a reply.

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "duration_ms")
total = base |> group() |> count()
bad = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome != "ok") |> group() |> count()
join(tables: {t: total, b: bad}, on: ["_start"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._start, _value: float(v: r._value_b) / float(v: r._value_t)}))

panels.title: Reply size — median and p90
panels.description: Sizes, never content. A collapsing p90 usually means replies are being truncated.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "reply_bytes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Which gate is failing builds
panels.description: failed_stage is the FIRST failing gate. This is the panel that turns 'a build failed' into 'route fails on every four-layer board'.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "synth.run" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.failed_stage)
  |> group(columns: ["failed_stage"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

panels.title: Synth runs, by source
panels.description: mcp is an external agent driving the toolchain; new_project is someone in the GUI.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "synth.run" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["source"])

panels.title: Designs that repaired themselves
panels.description: Cycles whose LAST attempt passed after an earlier one failed. Counting attempts flat would report each of these as several failures.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "synth.run" and r._field == "attempt")
  |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
  |> max()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Repair attempts per cycle
panels.description: How hard the loop is working. Climbing toward PHICAD_AI_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS (default 8) means designs are only just converging.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "synth.run" and r._field == "attempt")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Cost (USD), by model
panels.description: Provider-reported dollar cost per turn (phi --mode json), summed per window and grouped by the model tag. Turns whose backend reported no usage carry no cost_usd point at all — absence means unmeasured, never zero.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "cost_usd")
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "usd"})

panels.title: Spend in range
panels.description: Sum of provider-reported cost_usd over every measured turn in the time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "phicad" and r.event == "ai.turn" and r._field == "cost_usd")
  |> group()
  |> sum()
